settings.randomness: independent centered Gaussian innovations; deterministic designs

diagnostics.target: interval-specific innovation covariances V_i; no automatic pooling
diagnostics.bridge: V_i = integral_0^dt_i S_r C_i S_r* dr / dt_i, distinct from C_i

irregular_intervals.pooling_rejection_reason: irregular intervals have interval-specific V_i targets; pooling is unsupported. Use interval_diagnostics to inspect the transport bridge.

spline_projection.reference: four exact orthonormal exponential functions on the half-line
spline_projection.projection_metric: anchored weighted H; summed squared errors over four functions
spline_projection.boundary: spline constant tails; omitted exact derivative energy integrated analytically
spline_projection.interpretation: padding changes both boundary error and resolution at fixed basis size

conditioning.rejection_reason: exponential Gram matrix is ill-conditioned (condition=4.23e+33); use fewer or more widely separated rates

temporal_variation.terminal_window_note: requested terminal windows are wholly within the second regime
temporal_variation.post_change_note: same windows evaluated soon after the change to expose localization bias
temporal_variation.assumption: local covariance approximation declared; no automatic stationarity validation

metric_conventions.observed_covariance_rmse: Frobenius error for the full identity observation map
metric_conventions.off_grid_kernel_rmse: entrywise RMSE on the predeclared 31-point [0,3] maturity grid
metric_conventions.spread_risk_absolute_error: absolute variance error of predeclared f(1)-f(2)

performance.source_spectrum: full diagonal j^-2 spectrum normalized to trace one
performance.timing_scope: fit_covariance only; observations generated once per dimension before timing
performance.memory_scope: Python tracemalloc peak increase; native BLAS allocations not fully measured
performance.interpretation: bounded solver harness at a common certificate budget; no universal scalability claim

metric_conventions.observed_covariance_rmse: Frobenius error; the same diagonal observation map is used on all 64 dates
metric_conventions.off_grid_kernel_rmse: entrywise RMSE on the predeclared 31-point [0,3] maturity grid
metric_conventions.spread_risk_absolute_error: absolute risk error for f(1)-f(2), normalized to unit H-representer norm before data generation
